caption: The drawing features a square textile design centered on a plain, off-white background. The textile consists of a complex geometric pattern arranged symmetrically along a central horizontal axis. The primary colors in the textile are dark blue, beige, and a muted red. The blue and beige sections form an intricate checkerboard and radiating fan-like motifs that mirror each other from the center outward, while the red segments appear as horizontal bands that cross near the upper, middle, and lower edges, and as rounded shapes along the top and bottom borders. The weave pattern creates alternating rectangles and rounded shapes throughout the composition. The background remains unmarked except for small handwritten text and numbers near the lower left and right corners.
title: Coverlet Detail
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
